name: hospital-you-cant-get-into
why: Opens on 2.4 billion sick in front of a hospital whose only door is a mail slot, and pays off when the Reaper rolls up his blueprint over a crowd of skeletons with their hands still up.

name: oxford-did-something-crazy
why: Hooks with America filling out forms while Oxford tests drugs on the dying, stacks $500, a 30% drop in deaths and a million lives on one side, and pays off with the buried FDA surfacing to ask about paperwork.

name: siri-but-useful
why: Hooks on Googling 'is my poop normal?', escalates to YOU's foot falling off and the ranked options played out on him, and pays off with a lavender-scented remaining foot.
